# Step 1: Login Simple Note and fetch the 'Weekly Workout Plan' (or closest match) note content.
import datetime as dt

# simple_note login
sn_creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
password_map = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in sn_creds}

sn_access = apis.simple_note.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password=password_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

# find notes matching workout plan keyword(s) with pagination
keywords = ['Weekly Workout Plan', 'workout plan', 'workout', 'gym']

matches = []
seen_ids = set()
for kw in keywords:
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_access, query=kw, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by=None)
        if not res:
            break
        for n in res:
            if n['note_id'] not in seen_ids:
                matches.append(n)
                seen_ids.add(n['note_id'])
        page_index += 1

# pick best candidate: prefer exact title containing 'Workout Plan' else 'workout'

def score(note):
    title = note['title'].lower()
    s = 0
    if 'workout plan' in title: s += 5
    if 'weekly' in title: s += 2
    if 'workout' in title: s += 2
    # prefer non-habit logs (contains 'habit')
    if 'habit' in title: s -= 10
    if note.get('pinned'): s += 1
    return s

matches_sorted = sorted(matches, key=score, reverse=True)
print('Top note matches:', [(n['note_id'], n['title'], score(n)) for n in matches_sorted[:10]])

selected = matches_sorted[0]
print('Selected note:', selected)

note_full = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=selected['note_id'], access_token=sn_access)
print('Note content preview:', '\n'.join(note_full['content'].splitlines()[:60]))

# Fetch full note content and extract today's workout duration based on day name
import datetime as dt, re

# simple_note login using supervisor creds
sn_creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
password_map = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in sn_creds}

sn_access = apis.simple_note.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password=password_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

note_id = 3016
note_full = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_access)
content = note_full['content']
print('note title', note_full['title'])
print('content length', len(content))

# Determine today day of week
weekday = dt.datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
print('weekday', weekday)

# Parse duration_mins for the matching day
# Content format uses 'day: monday' lines and 'duration_mins: <num>' nearby.
# We'll split into blocks by 'day:' occurrences.
blocks = re.split(r'(?=day:\s*)(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\s*\n', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
# The split keeps delimiters; easier: use regex to capture day and duration.
pattern = re.compile(r'day:\s*(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\s*\n.*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)', re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)
found = pattern.findall(content)
print('found day durations', found)

# Map
durations = {day.lower(): int(mins) for day, mins in found}
print('duration for today', durations.get(weekday))

# Search for any playlist mention
playlist_mentions = re.findall(r'playlist[^\n]*', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
print('playlist_mentions', playlist_mentions)

def get_workout_duration():
    note_full = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3016, access_token=sn_access)

    content = note_full['content']
    pattern = re.compile(r'day:\s*(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\s*\n.*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)', re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)
